_doc: Lock file for hash-locked artifacts in katala-os. Compare a runtime hash against the value here; mismatch = drift, surface to NEEDS_REVIEW.md before acting. Update only when the change is intentional and signed.

CONSTITUTION.md.role: constitutional baseline; the deliberately-narrow subset that never drifts

drift_response: If a runtime hash does not match the value here: (1) determine if the change was intentional, (2) if yes, update this lock file in a signed commit alongside the file change, (3) if no, restore the file from git history.
